factors.PQ: replace predicted ordinary true load P/Q by the saved true ordinary load
factors.lines: replace trained R/X by true R/X in the true candidate
factors.source: replace predicted same-interface source P/Q by the saved true source

attribution_definition.interpretation: mean prediction-error allocation; excludes covariance and topology-decision-risk attribution
attribution_definition.rule: average marginal MSE reductions over the six factor orders; signed contributions sum to nominal MSE minus all-truth MSE
attribution_definition.target: clean complete AC mean MSE at the same saved action

distribution_definitions.actual_simulation: eight predeclared independent histories, two of each truth structure; one fixed latent trajectory per regime and 32 paired new meter-noise draws
distribution_definitions.averaging: equal history weight; regular/shift share history and plan; 32 draws are conditional replicates, not new histories
distribution_definitions.declared_Gaussian: per-history candidate mixture weighted by the saved evidence posterior; random latent process and new meters; 2048 integration samples per candidate
